sections.heading: Plot
sections.text:
Mysterious waterspouts and whirlpools on a river in France have been capsizing boats and almost drowning people. The Huntik Foundation believes a lost Titan called Gar-Ghoul is awakening, and its powers are causing these attacks. Dante Vale, Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill, and Zhalia Moon go to France to investigate.

When the heroes reach the river, they are attacked by Suits. After defeating the Suits, the team takes a boat upriver and encounters the magical whirlpools, which cause them to crash. Luckily, they find a hidden cave! Inside, a stone gargoyle blasts them with jets of water that hit as hard as bullets. To make things worse, DeFoe’s team shows up and attacks them too! DeFoe uses the battle as a distraction to steal Gar-Ghoul’s Amulet, but Lok discovers a secret chamber that may be more valuable than Gar-Ghoul.

full_text:
Prague, Czech Republic: Prague Central Cemetery

The clues left by Lok's father, Eathon Lambert, in his diary, lead the Huntik team down into the undergrounds of Prague. Lok and his group manage to unveil the myth of the golem and reach the Amulet of Metagolem. The Organization takes them by surprise, but a new Seeker, the mysterious and beautiful Zhalia Moon, intervenes to their rescue.

== Synopsis ==
Dante Vale is given the assignment to search for the mysterious Gar-Ghoul Titan, believed to be in Rouen, France, while developing Lok's summoning powers and his use with magical spells.

== Plot ==
Mysterious waterspouts and whirlpools on a river in France have been capsizing boats and almost drowning people. The Huntik Foundation believes a lost Titan called Gar-Ghoul is awakening, and its powers are causing these attacks. Dante Vale, Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill, and Zhalia Moon go to France to investigate.

When the heroes reach the river, they are attacked by Suits. After defeating the Suits, the team takes a boat upriver and encounters the magical whirlpools, which cause them to crash. Luckily, they find a hidden cave! Inside, a stone gargoyle blasts them with jets of water that hit as hard as bullets. To make things worse, DeFoe’s team shows up and attacks them too! DeFoe uses the battle as a distraction to steal Gar-Ghoul’s Amulet, but Lok discovers a secret chamber that may be more valuable than Gar-Ghoul.
